# Application developer guide index — 0.4.0

This is a **generated reference** from the frozen schema and capability metadata, not a statement of scanner implementation conformance. Pin the entire repository commit (or release tag when available), including documentation, schemas, specification and examples.

Read the [common contracts](../developer-guide/README.md), then the namespace families your application implements. Independent capabilities are optional shared capabilities, not an instruction to read UNIX documentation. Supported catalog status does not qualify a scanner.
